zh-Hans:
1.7.24（265）创作工具与图纸助手升级

• 二维 DWG／DXF：扩展绘制、选择、变换、图层、测量和标注；图纸助手支持对象定位、测量和确认后应用修改。三维继续查看，复杂对象按实际能力限制编辑，原图纸与 PDF／PNG 展示副本分开。
• 画布：图片、视频和图纸从原节点直接编辑；草稿可继续编辑，完成后更新原节点，只有“制作变体”才新增节点。媒体子工程和素材可随画布备份；包含 CAD 草稿和历史素材，备份恢复已通过定向测试。
• 图片：矩形、椭圆、套索、加减选、反选、羽化、复制／剪切／填充，以及更多图层、文字和调色操作。
• 视频：音乐波形与淡入淡出显示、精确裁切、逐帧定位、字幕样式和导出预设。
• 手记：正文搜索定位、选页 PDF 导出、工程归档，以及 AI 提案预览和确认。
• Office：完善 Word、Excel、PPT 的编辑命令、保存反馈和恢复；可用操作取决于文件格式及实际编辑引擎。
• 列表：独立字号、文件名显示和侧栏布局设置。

请重点测试：iPad 横竖屏／分屏、iPhone 窄屏，CAD 修改后保存重开，画布草稿与版本操作，图片选区／蒙版，Office 保存重开，手记搜索和选页导出。

说明：图纸兼容性只验证了代表性样例，不保证任意第三方文件无损编辑。原生 Office 的实机编辑保存、其他模型服务及实体设备性能仍待验证；图纸助手已通过一条真实模型查询、测量、确认修改和保存重开的模拟器流程。云端 AI 需自行配置服务；修改提案须确认，生成结果采用前不会自动覆盖当前素材。
en-US:
1.7.24 (265): Creative tools and Drawing Assistant

• 2D DWG/DXF: expanded drawing, selection, transforms, layers, measurement and annotations. Drawing Assistant locates objects, measures and proposes changes for confirmation. 3D remains view-only; editing depends on object/format support. Drawing files are distinct from PDF/PNG presentation copies.
• Canvas: open image, video and drawing editors from their original nodes. Resume drafts and apply edits to the same node; only Make variant creates another node. Media projects and assets travel with Canvas backups. Focused tests cover backup/restore of CAD drafts and revision assets.
• Images: rectangle, ellipse and lasso selections; add/subtract/invert/feather, copy/cut/fill, plus expanded layer, text and colour controls.
• Video: music waveforms and fade indicators, precise trimming, frame stepping, caption styles and export presets.
• Notes: text-search positioning, selected-page PDF export, project archives, and AI proposal preview/confirmation.
• Office: expanded Word, Excel and PPT editing commands, save feedback and recovery. Available operations depend on the document format and editing engine.
• Lists: independent text size, filename display and sidebar settings.

Please test iPad portrait/landscape/split view, iPhone compact layouts, CAD edit/save/reopen, Canvas drafts and versions, image selections/masks, Office save/reopen, and Notes search/selected-page export.

Limits: drawing compatibility was checked on representative samples, not every third-party file. Native Office editing/save on physical devices, other model providers and physical-device performance still need verification. One real-model Drawing Assistant query/measure/confirm/save/reopen workflow passed on the simulator. Cloud AI requires your configured provider. Proposed edits require confirmation; generated candidates do not overwrite current materials before adoption.
